part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the hooks `shouldComponentUpdate` installed by `useReducer` (hooks/src/index.js:343): when a component set state and then reverted it on the same tick, all pending state hooks settled back to their original values, so the SCU returned `false` and bailed out — discarding prop updates from the parent in that same tick.

The fix (mirroring upstream preactjs/preact#3739) is to also update when the incoming props differ from the component's current props: `return shouldUpdate || owner.props !== p ? ... : false`.
